evidence: Reviewed the seven-step counterexample with source A=40 and B=60 versus target A=50 and B=50.

The prose states that the counterexample establishes only the proof limit of count plus one sum, not the uselessness of control totals.
Exact-pass and hash-equality claims explicitly name their operational premises and probabilistic boundaries.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Mathematical consequence, system premise, and operational policy remain clearly separated.
